dev.title: Gifteez needs a Firebase config before it can sign in.
dev.body: Copy .env.example to .env, fill in the Firebase values, then rebuild the native app. Restarting Metro is not enough, because the env file is read at build time.
dev.safe: The app is running. Nothing was sent to a server.

firstOpen.sentence: Gifteez helps you remember gifts for the people you love, and keep the spending fair.

groupCreate.title: Name yourself
groupCreate.body: This silly name is how your group sees you. You can change it now, and only now.
groupCreate.name: Your name
groupCreate.listNameHint: Leave this blank and the list is named from the people in it, like Mike, Sam & Jo.
groupCreate.secureTitle: Save this group to your email
groupCreate.secureBody: Optional. A magic link keeps your list if you get a new phone. You can skip and do this later.
groupCreate.secondDevice: I already use Gifteez on another phone
groupCreate.linkSent: Check your email and open the link on this phone, or paste it below.
groupCreate.smsRegion: Text messages are limited to US numbers at launch.
groupCreate.recoveryBody: Write these words down. They unlock your list on a new phone after you sign in. Gifteez cannot read them.
groupCreate.showLater: You can view this code again on this phone from the group screen.

people.title: People
people.empty: Add the first person you shop for. A budget is optional.
people.banner: You have used Gifteez for a while. Saving an email keeps your list if this phone is replaced.
people.cap: The free list holds {count} people. A one-time unlock removes the cap.

person.name: Name
person.tagsHint: Tap any that fit. Ideas stay on this screen.
person.ideasHint: These are made on this phone from the name, occasion, and tags.
person.cloudHint: This is the only button that calls the cloud. Fresh answers count toward the cap.
person.openedImported: Opening this person turns ideas on. Imported people stay quiet until then.

fairness.title: Fairness
fairness.intro: This year, side by side. Lower spend is listed first.

groupScreen.title: Group
groupScreen.inviteHint: The link includes the key after the #. Anyone with the link can read the list. Groups hold up to {count} people.
groupScreen.nameHint: Blank uses the members' names. Showing as {name}.
groupScreen.ownerStays: Hand the list to someone else before you leave. You started it.
groupScreen.emptyCode: There is no recovery code on this phone.

join.title: Join a list
join.body: Paste the invite link from the person who started the list.
join.invalid: That link is missing the list, the invite, or the key.
join.recovery: Recovery code from your other phone
join.needAccount: Sign in with the email you saved, then enter the recovery code.

settings.title: Settings
settings.anonymous: This phone is signed in quietly. Saving an email or a US mobile number keeps the same list.
settings.exportHint: Sharing the list asks you to save your account first.
settings.storeMissing: The store has no product for this build yet. The rest of the app still works.
settings.pasteHint: CSV or JSON from Santa's Bag, Christmas Gift List Tracker, or a spreadsheet with a name column.
settings.optional: These are optional. Gifteez never imports anyone on its own.

importFlow.none: Nothing to add from that source.
importFlow.added: Added {count}. They stay quiet until you open them.

sync.offline: Saved on this phone. It will sync when the connection is back.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Your latest change is still on this phone.
errors.auth: Sign-in did not finish. You can keep going and try again later.
errors.functions: Cloud ideas are unavailable right now.
errors.capReached: The cloud idea cap for this person is used up.
errors.notConfigured: The server is not set up to confirm purchases yet.
errors.full: That group already has the maximum number of people.
errors.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
